## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `950180d848371dfdf38b00023e1b614490c040d3`
Local-runs: none

**Scope of this record.** PR #20899 for card #20879, one file: `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md` (+87/−10, blob `a893abb2778` → `62fe9587495`). The head is `950180d84…`, base `main` at `33b6e8bec`, merge-base `00a92e18d`; `main` moved three commits between the two and touched none of ADR-0005, ADR-0087, `protocol.ts`, `view.zod.ts`, `registry.ts`, the anchor record or the three pins, so the API diff and `git diff origin/main...HEAD` are the same hunks. The seat's `pr.diff` in scratch equals the API diff except the abbreviated blob-id width on the `index` line. Inputs: the card body and its four comments (including the dev report `5915610884`), the PR body and file list, the check-runs on the head, ruling comments `5910106571` and `5909085121` with the #20051 thread around them (`5856781584`, `5909437934`, `5909486308`, `5909498682`, `5913819354`), and PR #20868 (merged `9905e61ca2`, an ancestor of `origin/main`) read as landed code at `origin/main`. Quotations were compared byte-for-byte by a scratch text-comparison script; nothing was built, tested or re-gated.

**Check-runs on the head (read 2026-09-30T16:55:40Z):** 35 runs — 23 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 1 `in_progress`. Not green: `Lint & Repo Gates` — `in_progress` (a REQUIRED context; an honest reading, not a pass; the seat re-reads before adopting). Required contexts otherwise: `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Test Core` 1/6–6/6 and rollup success; `Dogfood Regression Gate` rollup success (shards skipped); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` skipped by the paths filter (a docs-only diff). `Check Changeset` success; `Check Documentation Links` success. An earlier read (16:4xZ) had four `in_progress` (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core (1/6)`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · workspace`); three have since completed `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff edits governed rule text (Tier H, `docs/adr/**`). Every sentence it adds or changes about what `saveMetaItem` stores was judged against `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` on `origin/main` (`33b6e8bec`, identical to the dev's reading at `00a92e18d` for this file).

**Status line (:6).**
- Ruling 甲 entry, "the storage switch itself, the ruling's last stage, is in force for `view` since PR #20868 (`9905e61ca2`)": TRUE. The gate is `if (singularType === 'view')` at `protocol.ts:17056`; `9905e61ca2` is #20868's merge commit (merged 2026-09-30T14:54:08Z, on `main`). "see the amendment notes under that addendum's persisted-document bullet": two notes now sit under the bullet (:353, :421), both indented inside it.
- New ruling B entry: matches ruling `5910106571`'s Ruled sentence and the code (`buildStorableViewNode` :1438–1472; the `else` branch :17082–17102). TRUE.

**Appendix (c) bullet (:337–351), each clause at the code.**
- `projectStorableViewBody` is exported at :1506 and called at :17062 as `projectStorableViewBody(request.item, parsed.data, reparse)`.
- "a key nothing declares is dropped": :1447–1449 (`parsed[key] === undefined` → dropped). "a declared key keeps its parsed, normalised value": :1451 (recursive, so a nested default is not stored either). "a moved key is stored under its canonical spelling (`groups` → `sections`, `visibleOn` → `visibleWhen`)": :1453–1463 plus the docblock; the spec folds both (`foldFormGroupsIntoSections`; `FormSectionSchema.visibleOn` "Normalized to `visibleWhen` at parse", `view.zod.ts:3732`). "a schema default the author did not write is not stored": :1456 (reproduced by the re-parse → skipped), in the converged arm; the fail-safe is stated in the note's item 2.
- ADR-0087 link: the heading `## Addendum (2026-08-01b) — flows reach the finish line too (#4454)` is at `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md:506` on the head and is unique (the 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-01c siblings slug differently). GitHub slug computed: lowercase, strip `(`, `)`, `—`, `#`, spaces → hyphens ⇒ `addendum-2026-08-01b--flows-reach-the-finish-line-too-4454`, which is the fragment the link uses. `check-adr-links.mjs` strips fragments (`target.split('#')[0]`, :268; header :100 says so), so this was checked by hand. The addendum's text carries the rule cited: "`storable` excludes schema defaults, and this is load-bearing".
- "The stored row re-parses to exactly what the save accepted": the convergence invariant, :1515 `storableEqual(again.data, parsed)`.
- "A key a client writes onto a stored `view` row and reads back after a reload is declared … so the parse keeps it": `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` (`view.zod.ts:6331`), `viewItemWireFields` docblock.
- "Every other type still stores its request body (`request.item`)": the `else` branch stores `request.item` after the two grafts (:17098) and `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` (:17109, a no-op for every type but `page`); a `flow` body is replaced by its canonicalized `storable` before the gate (:17002); three pre-gate strips run for every type (:16546, :16587, :16599). As a one-sentence summary it is the code's own wording (:17016 "every other type keeps its request body, with the grafts below") and the triage's permitted fact; the qualifier lives in the note's item 3. TRUE as qualified.
- "In force since PR #20868 (`9905e61ca2`); rows stored before it are not migrated": #20868's changeset says "Stored rows are not migrated and not re-read differently"; the registry entry is semantic (no D2 conversion; `entries/semantic/18.view-item-options-bag-refused.ts`) and states "Nothing is rewritten on read". TRUE.

**The "⚠️ Historical — superseded." paragraph (:399–403).** Same form as the file's own marker at :545 (a blockquote line reading `⚠️ **Historical — superseded.** Everything in this subsection describes the …`, main :468). Items 5 and 6 are pure context lines in the diff (no `-` line), so "retained verbatim" holds. "without the production count item 6 names, which the maintainer waived": item 6 (:412–419) makes "the count of stored `view` rows … measured against production `sys_metadata`" the landing precondition; `5909085121` records the maintainer's 「20051 不考虑现有的数据」 as waiving ruling 甲's item 4 measurement and the census bullet ("Stage (iv) lands without a count of stored rows"), and ruling `5910106571` restates it ("The stored-row census stays waived"). A fair reading.

**New note's provenance (:421–433).** 「同意  批次 #256」 is byte-identical to `5910106571` (double space included). The English quotation "a saved view stores the keys the author wrote, normalised by the parse: undeclared keys dropped, schema defaults NOT materialised" is byte-identical to the ruling's Ruled sentence. 「20051 不考虑现有的数据」 is byte-identical to `5909085121`. "director batch #256 item 3, Q2 = B" matches the comment's header. "Stage (iv) of ruling 甲 landed under ruling B in PR #20868, merged as `9905e61ca2`" is true. "Why B rather than the whole parse output: views and flows keep one rule, a stored row carries no schema default the author did not write, so it never pins the day's default or records a choice the author never made" is an unquoted paraphrase of the ruling's own text ("Views and flows share ADR-0087's rule that `storable` excludes schema defaults; a stored row never pins the day's default"; readings ① "one rule for views and flows" and ③ "A records unmade choices as made") — the ruling's reason, not the author's, and not presented as a quotation.

**Item 1 (Superseded).** The quoted bullet equals the deleted text at main :337–345 byte-for-byte (whitespace-normalised across the blockquote wrap); the quoted Status clause equals main :6's clause and is gone from the head's Status line. Deleted-sentence homes: every rule sentence of the old bullet is restated in the new bullet scoped to `view`; the generic "parsed body once every round-trip key is declared" principle survives in the ruling 甲 Status entry and the first note's title (:353–355). No rule is lost. Item 5's "the pins that hold that verbatim save stay green" and its `protocol-meta.test.ts` "preserves Studio-only auxiliary fields verbatim" are false today and sit under the Historical marker, with the new item 5 giving the present state.

**Item 2, each named example at the code.** `operator` normalisation: `ViewFilterRuleSchema.operator` preprocess (docblock :1219), stored as parsed (:1419–1422). Bare-array `exportOptions` → object form: docblock :1421, spec :6322–6323, pin `protocol.project-storable-view-body.test.ts:105`. `objectName` and a top-level `id` (undeclared, `.strip()`): pin `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts:583`, `protocol-meta.test.ts:586`. `sort[].id`: `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROW_DECORATIONS = ['id']` (:424), `stripViewConsoleDecorations` (:499), pin :577. `groups` → `sections` / `visibleOn` → `visibleWhen`: pin 1 :72, :85. Convergence loop and fail-safe: :1512–1520; the warning is deduped per `view|name` in `storableViewFallbackWarned` (:17070–17079), i.e. once per view per process; "nothing the author wrote is lost, only that row's defaults are pinned" is the code comment at :17067–17069; pin 2 :744 "warns once per view". All TRUE.

**Item 3.** "The two grafts no longer run on a `view` save": TRUE (they are in the `else` branch only; "special cases of the projection" is the docblock at :1482–1487). "Every other type still stores its request body, with the normalizations `saveMetaItem` applied to it before the switch": TRUE under the sentence's own reading — the ADR calls stage (iv) "the storage switch" throughout, so "before the switch" is temporal. Every `request.item` mutation a non-view type meets on `main` — `stripReadDecorations`, `stripDerivedProvenance`, `stripServedObjectColumns` (pre-gate), the flow canonicalization (#4542), the two grafts, `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` (#20101), `stampHtmlPageRequires`, `carryForwardRedactedCredentials` — exists at `9905e61ca2^` (grep counts 2–8 each; `projectStorableViewBody` 0), so none is newer than the switch. The sentence does not enumerate, so it does not inherit the anchor record's "only" (see ③). Triage direction `5914934930` ("⛔ Nothing about types the switch does not cover"): the text states only the permitted fact and this factual qualifier; no sentence speculates about widening the switch or about any named non-view type.

**Item 4 (Q3 = A).** The ruling: "Q1 = A and Q3 = A stand as the seat answered them (… a top-level `options` on the ViewItem wire is refused by name with the prescription to write `config.KIND`)"; the seat's answer (`5909486308`) was A, "refuse it by name on both ViewItem wire arms". Code: `options` is `z.never(…)` with an error callback returning `VIEW_ITEM_OPTIONS_REFUSED`, `.optional()`, in `viewItemWireFields()` (`view.zod.ts:5330`), spread into BOTH arms of `ViewItemWireSchema` (:5359–5366); the message prescribes `config.KIND` (:5296–5299); a zod failure leaves `saveMetaItem` as `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the issue path `options` (:17047–17054). The registry entry `view-item-options-bag-refused` (`registry.ts:18426`) is a semantic entry, as the note says. "the judgement the first note's item 6 left open": item 6 said only "is judged in the same step". "The flattened list overlay keeps its legacy `options` bag, judged key by key": `ListViewOverlayWireSchema` declares `options: ListViewOverlayOptionsSchema.optional()` (:6218), a strict object. All TRUE.

**Item 5 (the pins).** All three exist on `main` with the blocks described: `protocol.project-storable-view-body.test.ts` (`the converged arms`, `the converged: false fail-safe`); `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts` stage (iv) describes (`TOOLBAR_SAVES` it.each "carries no `type` the author did not write", "an undeclared key is dropped", "the persisted body parses to exactly what the save parsed", "a page is stored as sent, not as parsed"); `packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts:586` "stores the console's declared round-trip keys, and drops the `objectName` alias". The 2026-05-16 test list at :494–497 still says "unknown extras preserved"; it is the dated record of what was added then, and item 5 names and corrects it — consistent with the file's convention of dated addenda plus notes. Observation only (a later edit could mark that line; not this card's surface).

**Heading stability.** `Addendum — 2026-05-16 (c): spec validation on overlay save` is byte-identical at head (:312), `main` and the merge-base (1 hit each). `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__metadata-protocol__src__protocol.ts.json` is blob `ff850c05…` at both head and `main` (untouched) and cites that heading, so `check:adr-anchors` has nothing to move.

**Out-of-scope stale text seen, not judged against this PR:** :322–331 (the 2026-05-16 `resolveOverlaySchema` dispatch by `view`/`dashboard`/other → `null`) pre-dates the registry-driven `getMetadataTypeSchema` dispatch; it is not about the storage switch and outside the card's surface.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct. The diff publishes nothing: on `origin/main`, 82 tracked `package.json`, 69 non-private, 0 `files[]` entries naming `docs/adr` or climbing out of their package (my own census; equals the dev's numbers). No `.changeset/*.md` in the diff; the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` is `success`. `Clause-②: no` is on the PR body, the right arm for a docs-only diff that widens nothing and carries no breaking marker.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations in `5915610884`, each answered:
1. First WIP commit refused by the pre-push hook for a card-relation line, amended before any push — accepted; the four commits on the branch (`89783bdb9`, `934ff16ed`, `cb38cc02b`, `950180d84`) carry the model-free trailer pair and no model identifier; no remote history was rewritten.
2. Dependency build exited 1 (spec unbuilt) then rebuilt under the verify lock — a dev-side prerequisite, not a gate result; the check-runs above are the gate verdicts.
3. A second Status entry for ruling B — inside the dispatched surface (the Status line), one entry per decision-changing amendment per the file's convention; two entries dated 2026-09-30 is a fact of the calendar, not a defect.
4. Items 5–6 kept verbatim under the Historical marker — accepted; the file's own convention (:545), and the dated text is quoted, not edited.
5. No label / no PR assignee written by the dev — the seat's writes are in place: labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`; PR assignee `os-warren` mirrors the card; the PR is draft, as Tier H requires.
6. Worktree removed after the PR opened — hygiene; no effect on the head.

Out-of-scope finding (carrier: none), judged at the code: the anchor record's invariant says every other type is stored "with only the operator and `groups` → `sections` grafts applied". That "only" is narrower than `protocol.ts` — `withDeclaredPageTypeDefault` runs for every type at :17109 (filling `type` on `page` alone), a `flow` body is its canonicalized `storable` before the gate (:17002), and three pre-gate strips apply to every type — so the anchor's prose is incomplete. It does NOT make this PR's sentences false: the ADR's bullet and item 3 carry no "only", and item 3's "with the normalizations `saveMetaItem` applied to it before the switch" is exactly the hedge the anchor lacks. The anchor file is outside this card's surface (the dispatch forbade `scripts/adr-anchors/**` unless a cited heading changed, and none did). Disposition: an acceptance-note observation is the right carrier (not a defect, contract violation or authoring trap under Prime Directive #10); no escalation.

Landing note: Tier H — this record is not the landing word. The PR lands only on the maintainer's APPROVED review (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) with every check green; at this reading `Lint & Repo Gates` is still `in_progress`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20879-adr-0005-storage-switch-in-force`
Reviewed-by: `session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`

**VERDICT: PASS**
